The '''Duros Menagerie of Exotic Species''' was a [[Zoo/Legends|menagerie]] that was located in the [[Duros Sector]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Eventually, many of the Menagerie's animals escaped, becoming a major threat to the people of the Sector.<ref name="LoNH" />
